data.title: KSrelief Serves 25,000 Hot Meals in Central and Southern Gaza
data.content:
Gaza, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) provided 25,000 meals from its central kitchen on Thursday to the families most in need in central and southern Gaza.
    The meals are part of the Saudi campaign to provide relief to the Palestinian people in Gaza, and of the Kingdom's efforts through KSrelief to meet affected families' basic needs and strengthen their resilience.
    -- SPA
20:18 Local Time 17:18 GMT
